title: Pay statement detail screen
why: Detail pages carry a side panel, tabular data and a status chip: three things with an exact DS answer (DetailPageTemplate, Table parts, Badge) and three things agents love to improvise. The meta panel is legitimately either <MetaItem>s or a <Descriptions> list, so the rubric names the choice rather than one of them: measured 2026-08-14, three runs out of three chose Descriptions, which is what the registry says it is for.

forbidden.message: hand-rolled detail chrome — the structure comes from <DetailPageTemplate>
